WITH tx_sent AS (
  SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist,
         AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_shortint,
         AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvol
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, avg_shortint, avg_optvol,
         AVG(avg_shortint) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_avg_shortint
  FROM tx_sent
)
SELECT transreg AS transaction_ref,
       ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
       avg_shortint AS avg_short_interest,
       avg_optvol AS avg_option_volume_ratio,
       avg_shortint / NULLIF(mix_avg_shortint, 0) AS short_interest_ratio
FROM ranked
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
